summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine change in the composition of its Audit and Risks Committee. The Board approved a new committee structure with three independent members; Ms. Heloisa Belotti Bedicks remains as Coordinator and adds the Financial Expert role, while Ms. Rachel de Oliveira Maia and Mr. Reinaldo Duarte Castanheira Filho continue as members. Mr. Manuel Lino Silva de Sousa Oliveira steps off the committee but retains his position as Board Chairman. This is a governance matter, not a special situation.
